reason: I would make my CV for free and use the one free AI action on a good offer from my WhatsApp groups. After that I would just send the same CV to the other offers, or ask my cousin to fix it, like I always do.
objection: I don't know if a better 'match score' really gets me called back. Most offers in the groups never answer anyone, so paying for each try feels like throwing money away, and I'm not sure about putting my MoMo on a bit.ly link.
would_change_my_mind: If a friend or someone in my group tells me they got an interview because of the adapted CV, then I would pay 500 FCFA for a job I really want.
